subject: PO requirement exception — evidence & risk matrix
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@zenbridge.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for pilot

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this. We (ZenBridge) are kicking off a two-month pilot with one engineering team and we'd like to request a temporary no-PO onboarding so we can start consuming credits while the procurement paperwork is in progress. Expected spend for the pilot is ~USD 6,200 total over 60 days (est. $3k/mo).

Why we need it: our procurement team is slow to issue a PO for initial pilots and the integration work kickoff is blocking our mutual timeline. We can provide W9, commercial liability insurance, and a short vendor attestation. We do not expect to transfer any sensitive customer data to Redwood for this pilot — purely telemetry and usage metrics.

Attachments: zenbridge-trial-invoice.pdf (stub)

Request: can Redwood provision an invoice-only path or other temporary exception so we can start? If approved, we will fast-track the remaining onboarding forms and aim to complete the full vendor setup within 30 days.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

Best,
Julia Park
Head of Ops, ZenBridge
ops@zenbridge.com

---

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@zenbridge.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for pilot

Hi Julia — thanks for the clear summary and for the invoice stub.

Short answer: we can consider a provisional invoice-only lane for small pilots, but procurement and finance need certain evidence and guardrails before we can approve. To move quickly, please provide the following by end of day Monday:

- Completed vendor onboarding checklist (W9, insurance cert, primary contact, bank remit).
- Short business justification (one paragraph) explaining why pilot must start before PO.
- Confirmation that no regulated or customer PII will be shared during the pilot.

If you can provide those, I will draft a provisional approval request to Procurement with a recommended 60-day window, a monthly spend cap of $10k, and an automatic revisit at 30 days. Procurement will require completion of our PO Exception Form — I attached the template for your convenience.

Attachment: po-exception-form.docx (template stub)

I'll loop Naomi (procurement) and David (finance) to expedite review. Once we have the evidence, procurement will log a provisional ticket and finance will confirm payment terms.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@zenbridge.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement provisional approval: invoice-only onboarding (ZenBridge) — conditions

Hi Julia / Markus,

Thanks for the evidence pack and the clear commitment on scope. Procurement can approve a provisional invoice-only onboarding for ZenBridge under the following conditions:

1) Timebox: 60 days maximum.
2) Monthly cap: $10,000 (we'll place a hard alert on spend).
3) Evidence completion: vendor W9 and COI must be uploaded to our vendor portal (procurement link) and the PO Exception Form must be completed and returned.
4) Access controls: no access to customer data or production customer environments; only sandbox/test endpoints allowed.

Once the above are satisfied, I will create PROC-1245 and mark it as provisional-approved. Procurement will perform a 30-day checkpoint to decide whether to require a PO or extend the path.

Markus — please confirm you are comfortable with the conditions and that CS (Marissa) will gate technical access until procurement signs off.

Procurement ticket: https://procurement.redwood.com/tickets/PROC-1245

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference
aomi_feldman@redwood.com

Subject: Finance: payment terms & accounting requirements for provisional onboarding

On Fri, Jul 24, 2026 at 16:40 Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the evidence pack and the clear commitment on scope. Procurement can approve a provisional invoice-only onboarding for ZenBridge under the following conditions: ...

Hi all — finance here. A couple of quick items so accounting can process invoices during the provisional window:

- We require a completed W9 on file prior to approving the first invoice.
- Preferred payment terms: Net 30. We can discuss Net 15 if there's a compelling reason.
- Please route all pilot invoices to ap@redwood.com and include the PROC-1245 reference in the subject line.
- For ACH setup, we will need bank details from ZenBridge (or we can pay by virtual card if preferred).

If the provisional path is used, finance will not issue an upfront credit; we will process invoices on payment terms above. If ZenBridge needs a different billing cadence, confirm now so procurement and finance can evaluate.

Next steps: Julia — once you upload W9 and COI to the vendor portal and return the completed po-exception-form.docx, Naomi will mark PROC-1245 as provisional-approved and CS (Marissa) will open sandbox access.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Revenue Operations / Finance — Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com
